channel.title: Brazil Procurement HOT
channel.description: Government tenders from Brazil's national procurement portal PNCP across eight categories — health, education, works, transport, food, IT, services and supplies. Titles and one-line summaries are rewritten in our own words, with links to the official notices, updated every 30 minutes.

item.title: Ji-Paraná (RO) Health & medical procurement · electronic competitive bidding (concorrência) · closes Dec 14 #214
item.description: A public buyer in Ji-Paraná (RO) is procuring healthcare goods or services through electronic competitive bidding (concorrência), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,131,363.61; proposals close Dec 14, 09:30 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
